# platform-orchestrator_pipeline_policy (Resource) (RC)

> **RC feature:** This page describes Deployment Pipelines in the coordinated
> release candidate (Provider `2.5.0-rc.1`). Pipelines are not available in the
> current stable release from `main`. Use matching Pipeline RC components; Native
> execution requires explicit operator activation.

Manages one project's forward and rollback pipeline-use policy with optimistic concurrency. Import an existing policy using its project ID. Delete never disables protection: first explicitly update to enabled=false, an empty allow-list and empty forward/rollback defaults, then remove the resource in a separate apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "platform-orchestrator_pipeline_policy" "release" {
  project_id = "my-project"
  document = jsonencode({
    enabled             = true
    allowed_version_ids = ["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"]
    default_version_id  = "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
    rollback_defaults = {
      default_version_id = "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
    }
  })
}

# Replace the sample UUIDs with allowed published versions, for example
# platform-orchestrator_pipeline_version.release.id. Both directions are explicit.
# To remove this resource: first apply enabled=false, allowed_version_ids=[],
# no default_version_id/environment_default_version_ids, and rollback_defaults={}.
# Then remove it in a separate apply. Destroy never disables server protection.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) JSON policy configuration with required enabled, allowed_version_ids, and rollback_defaults ({} explicitly clears). Optional default_version_id and environment_default_version_ids. Revision is managed separately; use jsonencode(yamldecode(file(...))) for YAML. This resource owns both directions.
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resource_version` (Number) Server policy revision used for CAS. Concurrent edits fail rather than being overwritten.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import platform-orchestrator_pipeline_policy.release my-project
```
